name: Implementation Selection
description: Lets a project and a running program switch between alternatives by changing data, and fails loudly on a mistyped name instead of quietly running something else. A call is served by the implementation that a per-call name, an override, the environment, the lock or the recorded default chooses.
purpose: Choose which implementation serves a call, by a per-call name, an override, the environment, the lock or the recorded default, and refuse an unknown name by listing the valid choices.
approach: Resolve the implementation from a per-call name, an override, an environment setting, the lock or the recorded default, through declarations in code with one cascade or through a selection table, and refuse an unknown name by listing the valid choices.
out_of_scope: Deciding which is best; branching at every call site.
milestones: 1. Resolution correctness: a recorded run of the entry-point rival and of the chosen implementation on the selection cases. 2. Runtime selection: the selector resolves every selection case as specified: name, override, environment and table default.
measures_of_success: Every switch works from configuration alone and no typo falls back silently. Standing conditions: Switching is a data change; an unknown name fails with the choices; every listed implementation loads; a program that embeds the package carries no second copy of the default.
parameters: Solution id, implementation name per call, a context block, an environment variable, a deployment table, configuration overrides.
inputs: The implementations declared in code, the records' selected cell, an optional selection table of module:Attribute targets.
outputs: The chosen implementation's class and its configuration type.
usage_notes: Every swappable solution has declared implementations and a selected cell whose value equals the measured winner or a declared tie. The records' selected cell is the project default; let the metric decide it and leave it out of any selection table.
